_comment: transfer_s1 NUMERICS BRIDGE (Threat 1 — the gate the panel is blocked on). d=256, L1 vs L4, the SAME five seeds {1..5} the banked CPU cohort used (sparse_s1_boundary), run on CUDA. Pass condition (fixed in PREREGISTRATION.md): per-seed Delta(3600) agrees in SIGN on >= 4/5 AND pooled mean Delta within 2 SE of the banked pooled mean. Failure HALTS the study and becomes its own finding. This cell also yields the first real M-arm-venue ms/step measurement, which decides whether M stays at 12 seeds or escalates to 18.
